Goals.Goal: Every included native consumer follows the configured identifier; QA cannot write/read the release live endpoint, extensions or credential namespace or claim/register/remove the release default handler.

Canonical release credentials, macOS endpoint path, existing default-handler behavior and historical extension scan order remain unchanged; legacy extension scan belongs only to the canonical identifier.
Prove release and alternate namespaces without real host credentials, LaunchServices writes or application launch; retain CSEC logic except the auth service identity.

Constraints.Constraint: Keep original applied profile bundle unchanged. Separate sequential writer tree from verified frozen input; do not modify root integration, frozen product or frozen checkbox trees.
No versions, locks, feature gates, keychain credential operations, user profile cleanup, certificate signing, dependency installation, commit, push or native launch.
Use copied idle warm native caches in private scratch, offline locked Cargo, two workers and confined synthetic-home tests; do not mutate original cache or weaken the unrelated CF bookmark harness.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No credential migration, new extension auth behavior, global default-handler algorithm redesign, native QA launch or release work.
